description: VietPaw canonical URLs — proposed rules; review in the existing zone before applying

rules.description: Index documents to their clean canonical URLs (GET/HEAD only)
rules.expression: (http.host in {"vietpaw.com" "www.vietpaw.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/index.html"))

rules.description: Other page requests to HTTPS and non-www
rules.expression: (http.host in {"vietpaw.com" "www.vietpaw.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.host eq "www.vietpaw.com" or not ssl))
